facts.fact: The ministry's May 2014 WSIS+10 report says the government gave itself a national policy in 2004, the Cyber Stratégie nationale, now with ten years of implementation and the main reference framework for the information society.

The report claims ten years of implementation of the Cyber Stratégie nationale along three axes (legal and institutional environment, infrastructure and services, awareness), measured against WSIS commitments and not against the strategy's own targets.

The report lists steering bodies created for the cyber strategy: the COPSI strategic orientation council, the information society observatory and sectoral steering committees, plus the ANPTIC agency to follow major ICT projects.

The report says a sector policy with an action plan for its implementation was in preparation (en cours d'élaboration) in May 2014, alongside a digital economy policy and a universal broadband access strategy.
